title: Mission: Frog & Tadpole
subtitle: Build the frog and see how it grows from a tadpole.
summary: Meet the frog and tadpole, learn their parts, and see the life cycle.
activityInstruction: Watch the tadpole grow into a frog.
exploreInstruction: Choose each stage from eggs to adult frog. Drag the 3D model to look around.

lifeCycleStages.label: Frog eggs
lifeCycleStages.description: A frog lays soft, jelly-like eggs in the water. A tiny tadpole grows inside each egg.

lifeCycleStages.label: Tadpole
lifeCycleStages.description: The tadpole hatches with a long tail. It swims in the pond and breathes through gills.

lifeCycleStages.label: Tadpole with legs
lifeCycleStages.description: Strong back legs begin to grow. The tadpole still uses its tail to swim.

lifeCycleStages.label: Froglet
lifeCycleStages.description: Front legs appear and the tail gets shorter. The froglet can begin leaving the water.

lifeCycleStages.label: Adult frog
lifeCycleStages.description: The tail is gone. The adult frog has four legs, breathes with lungs, and can jump.
